categories.main_business_segments: Sekisui Kasei operates two main business segments: the Human Life segment, which covers agricultural and fisheries materials, food packaging, logistics, construction, and civil engineering materials; and the Industry segment, which includes automotive parts, industrial packaging, electronic materials, and healthcare materials. The company provides a wide range of foamed plastic products and related solutions for these sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include extrusion foaming, foamed sheet molding, suspension polymerization, impregnation foaming, and molding techniques. It leverages advanced polymer chemistry, micro-particle technology, gelation, and high-function material development, with a focus on lightweight, high-performance, and environmentally friendly materials. Production processes are increasingly incorporating IoT, AI, and digital transformation for efficiency and innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include food packaging manufacturers (notably FP Corporation), automotive OEMs and suppliers, electronics and display manufacturers, construction and civil engineering firms, and healthcare product companies. Major end markets are the food industry, automotive and mobility, electronics, construction, and healthcare sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Sekisui Kasei has a global footprint with operations in Japan, Europe (notably Germany, Czech Republic, Poland), North America (USA, Mexico), and Asia (China, Taiwan, Thailand, Indonesia, Korea). Sales are well-diversified, with approximately 43% of revenue generated outside Japan, particularly in Europe and Asia.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier, manufacturing and processing foamed plastics and related materials, and delivering both intermediate materials and finished products to OEMs and end users in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening profitability through high-value-added products, expanding the Industry segment, advancing environmental and circular economy initiatives, and accelerating global business development. R&D focuses on sustainable materials (biomass, recycled content), new functional polymers, lightweight automotive and electronics solutions, and digital transformation in manufacturing. The company aims to increase the share of eco-friendly products and achieve significant GHG emission reductions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated from the sale of proprietary foamed plastic products, materials, and molded goods to industrial and commercial customers. The company also engages in some licensing and collaborative development, but product sales remain the core revenue stream.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include other global and domestic foamed plastics and advanced materials manufacturers, such as JSP, Kaneka, and other chemical/materials companies. Sekisui Kasei positions itself as a leading innovator in lightweight, high-performance, and sustainable foamed materials, with a strong presence in both the Japanese and international markets.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In FY2024, consolidated sales reached 137.1 billion yen, with 3,294 employees. The company experienced a net loss of 6.28 billion yen due to impairment and restructuring in its European automotive business, and operating profit margin was low (0.5%). The company is currently in a restructuring phase, aiming for improved profitability and a return to growth through portfolio transformation and cost optimization.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Sekisui Kasei emphasizes lightweight, high-performance, and environmentally friendly materials that contribute to resource efficiency, energy savings, and sustainability in customer applications. Its unique value lies in advanced foaming technologies, integrated development from raw materials to finished products, and a strong commitment to circular economy and ESG principles, enabling customers to meet both performance and environmental targets.
